snippet.title: Yorda's Quest: A Lighthearted Magic Fantasy RPG - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Laughs and legends await you! Join Yorda, the country bumpkin with hopes of heroism, on a light-hearted romp through the land! Fight demons, gain friends, and yuk it up in this parody of classic RPGs!
